basics.name: Ryan Eloy
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 7 years building and operating production systems for fintech, insurance, and high-traffic consumer platforms. Works across the stack in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with the most depth in backend: event-driven services, third-party integrations, and serverless architectures on AWS. Has shipped a conversational AI product for a multi-million-customer operation and uses AI coding agents daily within a tested, review-first workflow. Works in English with distributed international teams.

work.name: Luby Software
work.headline: 2M+ req/mo
work.description: Cross-border payment gateway built as Node.js/TypeScript microservices on AWS.
impact: 2M+ API requests/month through a cross-border payment gateway with 13 direct acquirer integrations
Recurring card approval rate raised from 16.4% to 34.7% by fixing retry and rebill logic
highlights: Lead contributor to four core payment services within a team of about 12, building a cross-border payment gateway with Node.js/TypeScript microservices on AWS. The gateway handles 2M+ API requests per month and supports 13 direct acquirer integrations.

Fixed retry and rebill logic for tokenized recurring card charges, contributing to segment approval rising from 16.4% to 34.7% (+18.3 percentage points). Also contributed to customer-initiated payment approval improving from 85% to 89% (+4 percentage points).

Built and evolved integrations in Brazil and Mexico: a debit-card adapter, instant-payment flows, network tokenization, and a new Mexican provider (cards, bank transfer, Apple Pay) taken from scoping to UAT certification in about 16 weeks with 93 end-to-end scenarios passing.

Investigated and fixed production issues in the payment chain, including lost webhooks and callback timeouts. Resolved a fee regression and reconciled fee data across 114k records, addressing both event-delivery failures and data-integrity issues in payment processing.
Rolled out a masked-data observability standard across card and instant-payment processing, covering four services and their shared library.

Maintained project instructions, reusable workflows, and an MCP-served knowledge index for daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor). Combined AI-assisted delivery with the project's 4,700+ automated tests and manual review as quality gates.

work.name: AIR Compass (UOL)
work.headline: Multi-brand platform
work.description: Vue micro-frontends on AEM for an automaker's loyalty and subscription platform.
impact: Loyalty and subscription platform used across several vehicle brands of a global automotive group
Redesigned subscription screen shipped behind a flag, switchable without a deployment
highlights: Delivered web features for the loyalty and subscription platform of a global automotive group, used across several vehicle brands, with Vue micro-frontends on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), GitLab CI, AWS, and Salesforce.

Built the subscription coupon flow on the web: back-office coupon registration (percentage or fixed discounts, audience targeting, global redemption limits) and coupon selection at checkout, integrated with the voucher and subscription microservices.
Shipped the redesigned subscription screen behind an authoring flag, so the new and legacy versions could run side by side and the client could switch between them without a deployment.
Created a brand theme for the shared component library with CSS custom properties and coached a teammate through the process; worked in a nine-person squad across web, back end, iOS, Android, and QA.

work.name: Museu de Arte de São Paulo (MASP)
work.headline: 100k+ tx/mo
work.description: In-house ticketing platform and check-in app, built from scratch on Next.js and AWS.
impact: 100k+ transactions/month on an in-house ticketing platform that replaced a costly third-party product
Thousands of concurrent users on peak event days, on Aurora PostgreSQL with RDS Proxy
highlights: Built the museum's in-house ticketing platform from scratch (Next.js, Node.js, serverless API on AWS Lambda), replacing a costly third-party product for ticket sales and membership validation at one of Latin America's leading art museums.
The platform processes 100k+ transactions per month on Aurora PostgreSQL with RDS Proxy, supporting thousands of concurrent users on peak event days.
Shipped a React Native app for real-time check-in and ticket and membership-card validation; covered critical platform flows with Jest and Playwright.
Integrated multiple payment gateways and POS terminals, and owned infrastructure and delivery across AWS and GCP (Lambda, SQS, SNS, SES, S3, CloudWatch, Docker, GitHub Actions).
Resolved race conditions in ticket purchases and seat reservations, maintaining consistent seat allocation under concurrent requests.

work.name: MJV Technology & Innovation
work.headline: Millions of customers
work.description: Node.js services behind BIA, Bradesco Seguros' conversational AI on IBM Watson.
impact: Conversational AI assistant (BIA) automating support for an insurer serving millions of customers
WhatsApp, web, and phone channels, deployed inside a regulated financial institution
highlights: Developed BIA, Bradesco Seguros' conversational AI assistant, using IBM Watson NLU to automate customer and broker support for an insurance operation serving millions of customers.
Built the Node.js/TypeScript services connecting the NLU engine to its channels (WhatsApp, web, and phone), with Socket.IO for real-time messaging and MongoDB for conversation data.

Delivered the hybrid on-premise and cloud deployment (Docker) that let an AI product run inside a regulated financial institution, meeting strict security, compliance, and data-sovereignty requirements.
Worked in two-week sprints with product and UX, covering services with Jest and contributing React interfaces.

Built an internal ERP from scratch, plus a meeting-recording portal, a job board, and automated reporting tools; managed client Linux servers and deployments.
